overview_description.description:
Clicpiso is a proptech platform that buys and sells flats, offering a quick, simple and transparent proposal.

Founded by Francisco A. Moreno in September 2017, Clipiso was born with the mission of getting its customers to sell their homes immediately and buy the floor of their dreams with all the guarantees. or that, it puts the customer at the center of attention of its business model and relies on state-of-the-art technology to guarantee immediacy and transparency in a process that until now was opaque and complex. Clicpiso eliminates cost overruns and commissions based on its own algorithm based on big data technology and a multidisciplinary work team aimed at allowing its clients to sell and buy real estate at competitive prices.

product.name: Home Selling Service
product.description: An online residential property selling service that provides homeowners with a property offer and manages the transaction, documentation, and closing process.

product.name: Home Buying Service
product.description: An online marketplace and transaction service for purchasing renovated, unrenovated, and new-build residential properties listed by Clikalia.

product.name: Home Rental Service
product.description: A residential property rental service offering Clikalia-owned or managed homes through online reservation, tenant screening, contracting, and lease management.

product.name: Studio by Clikalia
product.description: A residential renovation service that plans and delivers property refurbishments, including renovation proposals, quotations, and renovation work.

product.name: Clikalia Corporate
product.description: A residential asset management service for organizations seeking to manage, optimize, and improve returns from housing portfolios.

product.name: Clikalia Mortgages
product.description: A mortgage brokerage and intermediary service that connects customers with lenders and assists with mortgage application and pre-contractual procedures.
